productType: Complex Project Production Harness for Codex

targetUsers.need: Build complex full-stack projects with Codex as the primary builder
Orchestrate multi-agent builds with clear state and handoff
Get projects from idea to working code with diagnostic safety net

coreFunction: Accept a project requirement → classify complexity → select build mode → generate blueprint → produce task graph → execute build (single or multi-agent) → run diagnostic gate → deliver

concreteUserFacingFunctions.description: User provides project path, description, or requirements file. Harness reads and classifies.
Auto-detect: file count, framework, auth, DB, multi-app, API count, risk level. Output: SIMPLE / MODERATE / COMPLEX.
Route to: Vanilla Mode / Build Lite / Build Pro / Diagnostic Gate Only, based on complexity and user goal.
Generate architecture blueprint: page tree, API outline, DB schema sketch, permission boundaries.
Produce dependency-ordered task graph with clear file ownership per task node.
Execute task graph: single-agent Vanilla or multi-agent allocation with state management.
Post-build: run Diagnostic Pack (Quick/Student/Full) as readonly safety check.
If diagnostic finds issues, user-approved targeted fixes only.
Persist project state, decisions, risks, progress across sessions.
Generate portable state for continuation in new Codex window.

successCriteria.MVP: One real complex project built end-to-end with Build Harness, passing Diagnostic Gate, with verifiable state
successCriteria.v1: 3+ real projects of different types built successfully
successCriteria.v2: Multi-agent build outperforms Vanilla on complex projects with measurable metrics
